output.summary: KEP-2249 adds a namespaceSelector field to PodAffinityTerm so pod affinity/anti-affinity can target namespaces by label, and adds a CrossNamespaceAffinity quota scope so operators can limit which namespaces may use cross-namespace affinity. The KEP is marked implementable at stage stable.
output.rationale: Pod affinity could only name namespaces in a static list, which fails when namespaces are created dynamically. A namespace selector addresses this, but reviewers flagged that it widens cross-namespace interference, so a quota scope was added as an operator control. Reviewers also raised performance and correctness concerns about namespace label changes, and the KEP was updated to only disallow empty selectors.

alternatives.option: Allow all namespaces via a dedicated flag or a "*" token in the namespaces list
alternatives.why_not: The KEP says this "makes the api slightly messy and limits use cases where only a select set of namespaces needs to be considered"; a label selector is consistent with pod selection.

alternatives.option: Use regexp/prefix matching on namespace names
alternatives.why_not: Reviewer liggitt was -1 because such matches "are not strong boundaries"; ahg-g's regexp proposal was not adopted.

alternatives.option: Allow affinity across all namespaces with no selector
alternatives.why_not: Raised by liggitt as a simpler option; ahg-g said he could not say it was sufficient and preferred a selector consistent with pod selection.

alternatives.option: Restrict the namespaceSelector operator to only "In"
alternatives.why_not: alculquicondor suggested it, but ahg-g proposed no constraints beyond disallowing an empty selector, since a common namespace label may be hard to arrange; the KEP was updated to match.

evidence.quote: Adding a new quota scope named `CrossNamespaceAffinity` that allows operators to limit which namespaces are allowed to have pods that use affinity/anti-affinity across namespaces.
defining a quota scope for cross-namespace affinity/anti-affinity pods would let a cluster admin easily set up a default cluster wide quota
I will update the KEP to include proposing a new quota scope, so NamespaceSelector and "CrossNamespaceAffinity" will be done under one feature flag.
I updated the KEP that we will only disallow empty selector to avoid accidental selection of all namespaces. Other operators are allowed.
This feature has been **fully implemented** and is now **GA** in K8s version 1.24.
